draft.title: Acoustic booths for open offices
draft.description: Booths that cut the noise of a busy floor by half. Each one seats two and is in place in a day.

blocks.heading: Acoustic booths for open offices
blocks.text: Our booths cut the noise of a busy floor by half. Each one seats two, fits through a standard door, and is in place in a day.

columns.heading: What fits where
columns.text: Single booths for calls, double booths for two people, and a meeting pod for four.

columns.heading: In place in a day
columns.text: We bring each booth in through a standard door and set it up while you work.

items.heading: Air that moves
items.text: A silent fan changes the air every two minutes.

items.heading: Moves with you
items.text: Lift it onto wheels and roll it to a new spot.

items.question: How long does fitting take?
items.answer: One day for up to four booths.

items.question: Do the booths need power?
items.answer: One standard socket runs the fan and the light.

items.question: Can we try one first?
items.answer: Yes. Come to our open day in Leeds and sit in one.
